title: Desert Diamond HTD Pool/Hot Tub/Tennis/BBall/Sauna
description:
This property is designed for the ultimate vacation experience, where every moment is filled with leisure and enjoyment. Step into our desert paradise with a heated pool and hot tub, perfect for a relaxing swim or soak. Enjoy friendly competitions with friends and family on the tennis and pickleball courts, or shoot some hoops. Gather around the fire pit for cozy evenings, or catch your favorite shows on the outdoor TV. Book your stay now and create unforgettable memories!

 The space 
Welcome to The Desert Diamond! 💎 This modern luxury home will provide you and your group the finest vacation to Scottsdale. With over 7000 square feet of modern and spacious living space on nearly a full acre of amenities this property has something for everyone!

The backyard oasis features a newly refinished refreshing heated pool with diving board, in pool seating and table, and overflow hot tub. Surrounding the pool you have multiple seating areas and 8 sun loungers to relax and unwind in the sunshine!
